{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"00000000000008YBVKJ7XC6E1Q","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram kind=sequence
node UI "App" ref="packages/apps/echo-sqlite-demo/src/client/components/App.tsx"
node Sync "connect()" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-sqlite-sync/src/sync.ts"
node DB "SqliteDatabase" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-sqlite/src/database.ts"
node DO "SpaceObject" ref="packages/core/echo/echo-sync-worker/src/space-object.ts"
edge UI -> Sync "connect(db, slug)"
edge Sync sends DO "pull since=seq"
edge DO sends Sync "records from..seq"
edge Sync calls DB "merge: add, update"
edge DB returns Sync "flushed"
edge Sync calls DB "read local records"
edge DB returns Sync "changed vs base"
edge Sync sends DO "push clientSeq+1"
edge DO sends Sync "ack accepted"
note Sync "base = stamped"
edge Sync -> UI "onSync"
